notes: Godot 4 .NET playable city-planner puzzle about placing bus stops and routes (Bus Routing Game). SPDX GPL-3.0 (LICENSE.txt). Art is original SVG/PNG; no bundled fonts or audio. Includes MIT gdUnit4 under src/addons/gdUnit4/ and an in-repo map-editor addon. Replaced the upstream default Godot icon.svg with an original bus-and-route mark (md5 dd385f8047fa32d7ba94f6bbc72a0e81). No Git LFS, no editor .godot, no signing keystore.
